source_config.experiment: Instructed learned steering coupled to CARLA
source_config.claim: Learned foreleg controls a passive wheel; requested turns and vehicle speed are scripted.
source_config.coupling: Read wheel at interval start; hold derived steer through one CARLA tick. Record both simulators at interval end.
source_config.inertial_feedback: Thorax supported; vehicle acceleration is not fed into the stationary cockpit dynamics.
source_config.turn_schedule: 0 until 2 s; +0.3 sin(2pi(t-2)/10) until 12 s; -0.3 sin(2pi(t-12)/10) until 22 s; then 0.
source_config.support_hand_control: Passive right foreleg attached to opposite rim; right position servos disabled; learned left foreleg supplies steering
source_config.pass_checks: Matching camera/world frames; clock error <0.0001 s; applied steer matches physical wheel mapping within 1e-7; finite body states.
